messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed a ~4% delta between invoice-preview and final invoices for tenant `milehi` this morning. Preview shows ~18k tokens, final shows ~24k. Digging looks like lots of mid-session tenant switches (user moved between teams)

sam: Oof. Are tokens being attributed to the wrong tenant, or are we double-counting?

maya: More like misattribution. Edge proxy emits a new client-id when the session crosses org boundaries, but the session-level fingerprint we use for dedupe is ephemeral and sometimes gets refreshed. So one logical session turns into two in the pipeline.

lee: That matches a pattern I saw in the ingest logs — `session_id` present on egress but not consistently propagated into the streaming path. Some consumers see a different `tenant_id` after enrich.

oz: Is this only for streaming (ws) sessions or for plain HTTP too?

maya: Mostly streaming because the KV cache + streaming proxy does a reconnect with a different client header. But we saw one spike from the HTTP bulk import flow too when the user changed org mid-upload.

aria: Quick question: what does preview pipeline use to collapse tokens? We currently dedupe by `routing_fingerprint` + `session_bucket` within a 5m window, right?

sam: Correct. preview uses routing_fingerprint + session_bucket. Final invoice uses the canonical `session_snapshot` from the tally service which expects `session_id` is stable. If proxies create multiple client ids, preview and final disagree.

maya: Proposed fix: make session-id propagation deterministic at the edge and fall back to a deterministic fingerprint derived from user cookie + first-tenant for the lifetime of that session. That would keep the session stable even across tenant-change ops during the connection handshake.

lee: I can add middleware to the streaming proxy to set `X-Session-Id` if absent based on `cookie:session` and `x-tenant-first`. Pseudocode: 

```
if (!headers['x-session-id']) {
  headers['x-session-id'] = sha1(cookie.session + '|' + headers['x-tenant-first']);
}
```

maya: Exactly. Then downstream enrich/ingest should prefer header `x-session-id` over generated ephemeral ids.

oz: Two asks: 1) telemetry — we need a metric for how often session-id is regenerated per connection; 2) rollout plan — canary and fallback.

aria: For telemetry, add a tag on the ingest event: `session_id_origin: header|generated|recomputed`. Then dashboards can show percent by origin.

sam: For rollout, canary on 5% of traffic in us-west for 48h. If preview vs final drift reduces by >2% then ramp. If we see any increase in 500s from the streaming proxy, abort.

lee: I'll open a PR for the proxy middleware and a config flag `feature.stable_session_propagation` default false. Can add a health-check hook to the canary that watches `proxy_5xx_rate`.

maya: Also we should add a short reconciliation query to catch past misattributed windows: join preview events to final tallies by `user_cookie` + approximate time window and generate an audit CSV for accounting to evaluate manual adjustments.

sam: Agreed. Suggest a one-off Spark job: group by `user_cookie, day, model_alias` and compute preview_tokens vs final_tokens, output where abs(diff) > 500 tokens.

aria: I'll add the `session_id_origin` field to the ingest schema PR and update the Console dashboard: Preview vs Final delta time-series + heatmap by `tenant` and `session_id_origin`.

deploy-bot: deploy started: eng/stream-proxy@pr-4123 to canary-us-west

billing-bot: Note: any reconciliation adjustments must be approved by finance before applying credits. Use /finance-request with CSV link.

lee: PR is up: https://git.redwood/eng/stream-proxy/pull/4123 — includes middleware, unit tests, and a toggle. Also added metric `streamproxy.session_id_regen_count` tagged by `reason`.

maya: thx. I'll kick off the Spark job and post the CSV. @sam can you own the canary watch for the first 24h?

sam: Yep, I'll watch alerts + preview/final diff dashboards. Slack alert if diff trend > 1% and page if >3% and persists 30m.

oz: One more edge: what about long-lived KV caches? If a new x-session-id is used but cache was filled under the old id we might undercount or overcount tokens on replay. Need to ensure cache key includes `tenant_id` + `session_bucket` not just session id.

lee: Good call. I'll update cache key to be `sha(tenant_id + '|' + session_bucket)` so tenant switch invalidates the cache intentionally (we want separation), but session propagation will keep session identity across tenant changes only for accounting.

maya: Sounds like a solid plan. Goal: reduce preview/final invoice mismatches <1% and give finance a clear reconciliation for the past 7 days.

aria: I'll schedule a quick Console UX patch to show `session_id_origin` in the session detail flyout so support can triage faster.

sam: Cool. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:

maya: CSV posted: https://s3.redwood/recon/milehi-session-delta-2026-02-09.csv — finance pinged.

billing-bot: finance-request created: FR-9842 for tenant `milehi`. Assigned to @tara-finance.

maya: closing loop when canary finishes — thx everyone.
